item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Food Industry Monitor (SC. GASTRONOMICHE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-27 23:59
Institution: SC. GASTRONOMICHE, Bra, Loc. Pollenzo
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-06 Economia aziendale

Participate in the conduct and development of the Food Industry Monitor research project, contributing to the updating of the database on companies in the food sector, with particular regard to updating the variables measuring economic performance and those measuring sustainability choices. Develop quantitative and qualitative analyses of the companies in the sample, contributing to the development of scientific publications in international journals that enhance the value of the database contents.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 23:59
Institution: Univ. Bocconi MILANO, Milano
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-03 Demografia e statistica sociale

WELFAIR studies intergenerational equity amid demographic and technological change and growing inequalities, assessing the role of social investment policies. The Post-Doc will contribute to Work Package 6, “Demographic Change”, led at Bocconi by Dr Matt Parbst, examining fertility, return to work after childbirth and early labour market exit due to care responsibilities or ill health. Tasks include harmonising European demographic data (2000–2025), analysing EU-SILC and SHARE longitudinal data, and applying the “Life-Cycle–Social-Change” model to distinguish life-cycle, cohort and period effects. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: COMPETITION FOR N.1 RESEARCH CONTRACT, GROUP 13/STAT-01 STATISTICSAT “DONDENA” RESEARCH CENTER AT UNIVERSITÀ COMMERCIALE “LUIGI BOCCONI” DI MILANO (Univ. Bocconi MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-30 23:59
Institution: Univ. Bocconi MILANO, Milano
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/STAT-01 Statistica

The Ageing and Longevity project, coordinated by M. Bonetti and L. Mencarini in collaboration with Università Cattolica in Cremona, aims to explore the relationships between ageing, longevity and prevention, with particular focus on the older ages. The work will consist of theoretical and applied research in the area of survival analysis. The topics will involve theoretical proofs which will also make use of empirical process results. Additional topics will include mixed models for longitudinal and clustered binary data, and latent disease history models for the study of disease onset.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Algorithmic Decisions and Market Efficiency: AI in Credit and Platform Markets (LUISS G.Carli ROMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 14:00
Institution: LUISS G.Carli ROMA, Roma
Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-01 Economia politica

This project studies how artificial intelligence (AI) adoption affects market outcomes in the presence of market failures. We focus on two settings. First, we examine financial markets where banks with market power face asymmetric information about borrowers. By integrating reinforcement-learning algorithms into a structural model of credit supply and demand, we assess how AI pricing tools alter equilibrium prices, credit allocation, and risk exposure. Second, we analyze online platforms where AI recommender systems shape user interactions. We model how these systems generate externalities—both user- and platform-driven—affecting content diversity and welfare. Combining structural modeling…

item.description:

Field: Economics and statistics / 13/ECON-01 Economia politica

The project develops an artificial intelligence system that transforms decision narratives into explicit, verifiable causal models, identifying actions, mechanisms, expected outcomes, evidence, and hypotheses to test. Based on language models and validated against an expert-annotated benchmark, the system will enable comparisons between politicians’ and experts’ narratives, assess their persuasive effects, and analyse their diffusion. It will also support entrepreneurial decision-making, helping startups articulate and test business hypotheses.
